title: Understanding the Condition
text: To find top performers on EdStem who do not hold discussion sections, consider two conditions: the number of hours spent on EdStem and whether the staff member holds a discussion section.

title: Checking EdStem Hours
text: Focus on the condition related to EdStem hours. You need to check if the staff spent at least $$15$$ hours on EdStem. How would you express this condition using the $$'ed_{hours'}$$ column?

title: Identifying Non-Discussion Holders
text: Consider how to identify staff members who do not hold discussion sections. What value does the $$'disc_{day'}$$ column have for these staff members?

title: Combining Conditions
text: Combine the conditions for EdStem hours and non-discussion holders. Which logical operator would you use to ensure both conditions are met?
